book.name: KOLOSE
book.title: MUKAANA A POOLE KUNDAA BASI KOLOSE

content: Bamfumu, liikagyighili mandagha ma mabwe ya mama bunsumu kundaa bankana ba be, bu lisoolo ti behe si lili a Mfumu ku yulu.
Maluo mama masini
Liikasa mukama mu lisamana, ya mu lo, liikakahala mihi ya liikabvurulu Nzaami matuono.
Liikasamana si mu bihi, mpaala Nzaami agwa bihi matala ma mafaana mu oluo Ndagha a nde, ya mu kuulu me ndyele mansweghe ma Kriste. Me mu nkooro a mansweghe mamo me ndi mu boloko.
Liikasamana mpaala me ntsala nsia a mansweghe mamo epankala, ti bwunu a bu mfaana me mo otsala.
Liikadzyara mu bunsughu ya baara baba ku mbala. Liikasalala matala.
Nyaã mbiili a be yikakala yimbwe mu nswe matala, yi oto mungba, mpaala be lisoolo bu lifaana ogwa mvuru kundaa nswe mbwuru.
Mamboro mama masini
Mu mi mitala me, Tisyike wu li ndughu a me mu kana wu mukolo mu Mfumu, musala wu bakughu osa kana mu nde, mbaala a me mu esala, sa agwa be mansia mwohono.
Mu mpere me aangweghe be nde, mu kuulu be lisoolo bu lili bihi ya mpaala nde agwa be bukyini.
Me ngweghe nde ya Onesime, ndughu mu kana wu mukolo ya wu bakughu osa kana mu nde, wu li wu a ndaa be. Bo sa balyele be mandagha mwohono ma mali mu okaluru kunu.

Arisitareke nganda a me wu a boloko gwi be mboro. Mareke, mudzighi a Baranabase ndehe si gwi be mboro. Me mu nkooro a Mareke munde áli bágwi be litumu ti, kala nde gyi kundaa be, ligyighili obwana nde.
Yiisu si, wu baakata ti Yusutuse, gwi be mboro. Ŋa kara li ba-Dzwife, yini a bo baakasala ya me mu otsala nsia a Emfumu e Nzaami. Me bo baakagwa me bukyini.

Epafarase, musala a Yiisu-Kriste, wu li wu a ndaa be gwi be mboro. Matala mwohono nde aakadzwana mvulu mu nsamana a nde mpaala be ligyighili otemene, likulu mu mufulu, ya likala ba bakughu ogyighili mandagha mwohono ma ookadzyi Nzaami.
Me nsuo bumpughulu mu nde ti nde aakamono mpara yi alagha mu nkooro a be, mu ba bali ku Lawodise ya ba bali ku Yeropolise.
Luke, ngaa-libughu, ndughu a bihi wu mukolo, gwi be mboro. Demase si gwi be mboro.
Ligwa bandughu mu kana ba bali ku Lawodise mboro, bumõ si kundaa Nimfa ya kundaa libwunu li Nzaami li liikabvuŋunu mu nzo a nde.
Be limana otala mukaana wu, lisa kuulu ti batala nde si kundaa libwunu li Nzaami lili basi Lawodise. Ya behe si akala litala mukaana munde wu aafa kundaa basi Lawodise.
Lilyele kundaa Aresyipe ti: «Sa mayele mu esala e Mfumu ki aabagha we, mpaala we gyighili osala kye!»
Me Poole ngwi be mboro, meme nsomo yo. Liikalibili mweẽ ti me ndi mu boloko. Nyaã bwehe bukala ya be!
